description: This file defines a CityAdapter class for displaying a list of City objects within a RecyclerView in an Android app. It handles view creation, data binding, and user interactions for city items.

classes.name: CityAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for presenting City objects in a RecyclerView, with click handling.

classes.name: CityAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to city item views.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with a new list of City objects and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates the view holder for each city item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds city data to the ViewHolder views and sets up click listeners.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of city items.
